Usage: mlfpkg [--manifest FILE] [--build-dir DIR] [--cache-dir DIR] [--compiler TOOL] [--clang TOOL]
              [--pkg-config TOOL] [--runtime FILE] [--gc-prefix DIR] [--timeout SECONDS] [--jobs N] [--locked] [--offline]
              [--pgo-generate TARGET | --pgo-target TARGET --pgo-use FILE]
              plan | lock | build [--target NAME ...] | test [--target NAME ...] | run NAME [-- ARGS...]
              release DIRECTORY | pack RELEASE_DIRECTORY ASSET_FILE
Package manifests: mlf-package.json. Dependencies select local source, checked directories, or pinned GitHub release assets.
mlf.lock is stale; review local changes and run mlfpkg lock
multiple local BDWGC installations; select one with --gc-prefix or MLF_GC_PREFIX
